- Confirm signing order: do you want the Order Form and MSA to route to the same signer(s) simultaneously, or sequentially?
- If a PO number or internal approval code is required to complete countersignature, please provide it so we can populate the Order Form fields before sending.

We propose the following routing on our side: 1) Brightwell signer (signs MSA + OF), 2) Redwood exec (final countersign), with the audit log and a final clean PDF pushed to the shared Drive folder listed below. If Brightwell needs a specific certificate of authority (POA) or signed corporate resolution, please attach it or indicate the path.

Tentative timeline: We can prepare and send the DocuSign envelope today if we get confirmation on signer authority and routing by EOD.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_Redlines.docx, OrderForm_Brightwell_v1.pdf

Thanks — Rafael
